title: 7 Best Durable Alternatives in 2026: Honest Comparison
summary: Durable alternatives ranked for small businesses that need more than a one-minute template site. Blink, Wix, Squarespace, Base44, Hostinger — honest pros and cons.
body_markdown: Durable is best for a solo, one-person service business that needs a live site in about a minute and doesn't expect to make many specific, unusual changes afterward. It explicitly isn't designed for ecommerce, and structure locks the moment the site generates.
